title: Stage 1: durable shared test-run registry, observation adapters, UI and restart evidence risk
outcome: The running-host prerequisite supplies versioned durable run registration and query visibility, host-observed declared and built-in test commands, the shared global UI/index and conservative evidence-risk computation. Production launcher behavior remains unchanged; stage 2 waits for deployment capability verification after the separately coordinated restart.
acceptance: S1 (test): The host accepts idempotent registration for an exact run identity, rejects immutable identity conflicts, and acknowledges only after the registration is durable and queryable. Persistence failure never produces an acknowledgement; duplicate/lost-ack requests produce one record. Production launcher behavior is unchanged in this prerequisite.

S2 (test): Registered runs and host-observed recognized test commands share the global run API/list and app-shell activity indicator, independent of the owning session being open or active. Records distinguish launcher registration from command observation; preserve available ownership, source, execution and artifact metadata; and survive reload/restart without inventing execution status or losing unresolved evidence risk.

S3 (test): The host and UI implement the parent's current C3 risk contract, including exact correlation, all associated work/check lifecycles, explicit unknown, terminal unresolved retention and conservative restart handling; registration or observation alone grants no credit.
S4 (test): The maintained full gate passes on the exact committed prerequisite tree, and the required independent review has no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher findings.
